product.name: Wavedash Web Gaming Platform
product.description: A browser-based gaming platform that runs games at near-native speeds without downloads or installations using modern web technologies.

product.name: Wavedash Developer SDKs and APIs
product.description: Software development kits and APIs that facilitate easy porting of games to Wavedash with minimal code changes and support for multiplayer and cloud features.

product.name: Wavedash Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for games with a 10% revenue fee, offering developers a platform to sell games with lower fees than many competitors.

product.name: Wavedash Global Web Distribution
product.description: A web-based distribution service that enables games to be instantly accessible worldwide on any device with a modern browser.
